mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attach_file ( original_name, save_name, file_path, file_size, ext ) VALUES ( #{originalName}, #{saveName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{ext} )
mapper.select: SELECT file_id as fileId, original_name as originalName, save_name as saveName, file_path as filePath, file_size as fileSize, ext, created_at as createdAt FROM attach_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
